key_provisions_or_claims: Adds HESA (Iran Aircraft Manufacturing Industries Corporation) to Annex I of Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 sanctions list.
Listing based on HESA's development and supply of UAVs used by Russia against Ukraine.
Enters into force on publication; binding and directly applicable in all Member States.
annotation.summary_en: Council Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/192 adds Iran's HESA aircraft manufacturer to the EU sanctions list under Regulation 269/2014 for developing and supplying UAVs used by Russia in its war against Ukraine. It is a sanctions listing, not AI governance.
